attacks.name: Disintegration Blast
steps: After this attack is resolved, this character gains |!power| equal to the |!damage| dealt.
|!wild| |*Degeneration|: After this attack is resolved, the defender cannot have |!damage| removed from it until the end of the |*Activation Phase| this Round.

attacks.name: Tolerance is Extinction
steps: |!hit| |*Degeneration|: After each attack is resolved, the defender cannot have |!damage| removed from it until the end of the |*Activation Phase| this Round.
|!wild| |*Suppression|: After each attack is resolved, the defender loses 1 |!power| for each |!wild| in the attack roll.
|!critical| |*Nanotech|: After each attack is resolved, the defender gains the |§root§Root| special condition.

superPowers.name: Operation Zero Tolerance (Affiliation: Sentinels)
superPowers.body: When an allied character makes an attack, if the defender would gain |!power| for |!damage| dealt by that attack, the defender gains 1 less |!power|. If the defender has a greater |!threat| than the attacker, the defender gains 2 less |!power| instead.

superPowers.name: Advanced Teleportation Matrix
superPowers.body: Choose this character or another allied character within |!range| 2. Place the chosen character within |!range| 2 of its current postion. A character can be Placed by this superpower only once per Turn.

superPowers.name: Prime Nano-Virus Reanimation Protocols
superPowers.body: When another allied non-Grunt character within |!range| 5 is Dazed or KO'd by an enemy effect, after the effect is resolved, this character may use this superpower. Choose 1 enemy character that caused the effect. The chosen character gains the |§root§Root| special condition and suffers 1 |!damage|.

superPowers.name: Enhanced Sentinel Cybernetics
superPowers.body: During the |*Power Phase|, this character gains 1 additional |!power|. Additionally, when this character would suffer 1 or more |!damage| from an enemy effect, reduce the amount of |!damage| suffered by 1, to a minimum of 1.
